products.title: Samsung Galaxy Book4 15.6" FHD Laptop
products.description: The Samsung Galaxy Book 4 is a portable and slim 15.6-inch laptop designed for durability and performance. It features a full aluminum body, an FHD anti-glare display with a 170-degree viewing angle, and Dolby Atmos sound for an immersive experience. Powered by an Intel Core 7 150U processor, 16GB of DDR4 RAM, and a 512GB NVMe SSD, it provides smooth performance for multitasking, photo, and video editing. The laptop includes a backlit keyboard, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, and a long-lasting battery capable of up to 10.9 hours of use.

products.title: Samsung Galaxy Book6 14.0-in Laptop Intel Core 5 315 – 8 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD
products.description: The Samsung Galaxy Book6 is a sleek 14-inch laptop designed for everyday productivity and efficiency. It features an Intel Core 5 315 processor, 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM, and a 256GB SSD for fast boot times and responsive performance. The device boasts a WUXGA (1920 x 1200) display and integrated Intel graphics, making it suitable for work, study, and entertainment.
